text: Every row opens its register asked for exactly what it counts: a quick view, the kept rows, or the one record's preview open.
The CVE row lands on Vulnerabilities with only CVE-2024-6387 kept and its operational issue's preview open.
Every count is read from the list the row opens: 17 past due, 3 due soon, 40 with no owner, 54 to revise, 88 pending.
The assessment row counts the 88 requests the campaign shows as Ready, instead of 89 controls no screen listed.
After SSP 3 is submitted its row moves to Waiting on others: SSP 3 waits on Joel Barrantes, the ISSM · In review.
The callout's action is Open offer and opens the CVE-2024-6387 offer itself, on the Mission Computer's Findings tab.
Each program card opens: WS-X90 its overview, the others Programs with that program's preview; Other programs rows do the same.
A program created in this session is listed first, 0 of its controls satisfied, and opens its own page.
Header, All tab, Kind counts and pager come from one list; Evidence to accept is the Evidence register's 88 plus 8 elsewhere.
The Kind filter works: choosing a kind keeps its rows and the pager counts that kind.
After SSP 3 is submitted the queue lists it as SSP to approve, waiting on Joel Barrantes; its preview opens the review.
The component offer's Review offer opens the offer, instead of a toast.
After SSP 3 is submitted, In the package reads In review, submitted today, waiting on Joel Barrantes.
Each readiness fix opens the editor at its section or control, scrolled there and focused; Draft a rationale lands in section 2.
Submit, approve, request changes and withdraw write one review state that My work, the queue and Authorization read.
Add person is the primary: name, role and start date, checked before it closes; it starts the role's onboarding task set.
After Reassign all on Victor Amsel's offboarding, Nadia Fournier holds the quarterly review and Victor has no open tasks.
The People tab and the quick views count the rows they list, added people included.
Nothing is ticked when People, Inventory, Scope changes or the access review opens.
Each onboarding task row opens its preview; Mark complete completes it and moves the person's progress and People's row.
Keep and Revoke move 11 of 18 decided; Show all lists all 18 accounts, so every one can be decided.
Complete review names what is still owed (owners, decisions, notes) and completes once nothing is.
Assign owner has a required Owner choice and sets the account's owner, moving the checklist.
Note or task has real fields, a required task name, and records the task on the revoked account.
After Reassign all the quarterly review and its to-do name Nadia Fournier; completing it completes the Schedule's task.
The quarterly review's task follows the reassignment and completes when its review completes.
Add asset opens a dialog that adds the asset: counted on the tab and in the groups, its row kept and preview open.
Import scan opens its dialog and says plainly that the prototype does not import.
Create program makes the new program the current one for the rest of the session.
The switcher names the new program; its badges are its own; the starter guide's links open its own pages, not WS-X90's.
The switcher lists the created program and WS-X90; choosing one makes it current.
A created program is listed (Planned, 0%), counted in All and Built from a product, and opens its own page.
The menu's badges are read from the pages they open: Evidence 368 as the register's All, Getting started 20% as its checklist.
The rail's My work counts My work's rows and Review counts the queue's own total.
While a campaign is open in the assessment band, the menu holds its pages: Requests, Findings, Controls, and a way back.
The CVE-2024-6387 row opens its operational issue's preview instead of nothing.
A task nobody has started reads To do in grey; Open stays the red word for open issues and risks.
Nothing is ticked when the Schedule opens.
The campaign's Controls page keeps the reader in assessment mode, with the band and the campaign's menu.
